justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/event/EventListenerSupport.java, EventUtils.java, and package-info.java. The package has only two production classes and no production fan-in: rg found no references to EventListenerSupport or EventUtils outside src/test/java. Its outgoing dependencies are core Commons Lang utilities (ArrayUtils, Validate, ExceptionUtils, FailableConsumer, MethodUtils), which are themselves reused across many other production packages such as concurrent, text, builder, reflect, and function, so this package is not a stable, highly depended-on package depending on less-stable ones.
